sanskrit_verse: मूल्यं दत्त्वाधिकं न्यूनं मूल्यस्यानुचितं स्मृतम् । क्रयसिद्धेस्तु नैव स्याद्वत्सराणां शतैरपि ॥
transliteration: mūlyaṃ dattvādhikaṃ nyūnaṃ mūlyasyānucitaṃ smṛtam | krayasiddhestu naiva syādvatsarāṇāṃ śatair api ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When value is given in excess or deficit to what is appropriate for the transaction, the completion of purchase is invalid even after hundreds of years.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in alignment with intrinsic worth, not temporal passage
Causation arises from imbalance in exchange-value relative to dharma of transaction
Capacity-based responsibility lies with the initiating agent who distorts transactional integrity
Restoration logic demands nullification until true equivalence is restored
Consciousness alignment requires recognition of dharmic measure in all exchanges
executable_legal_axioms: IF transaction_value ≠ dharmically-appropriate-value THEN transaction_status = invalid UNTIL restoration_of_equivalence
IF time_elapsed > threshold AND value_imbalance_exists THEN validation_remains_false
IF equivalence_restored THEN transaction_validity = true ELSE false
supreme_court_application: In commercial disputes involving valuation discrepancies, the Supreme Court shall invalidate any transaction where the exchange deviates from its dharmic measure regardless of time elapsed. The court's role is to enforce alignment with intrinsic worth rather than uphold defective contracts through precedent or limitation statutes.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that factual distortion in value negates contractual truth. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that imbalance perpetuates misalignment across economic consciousness. Proportional responsibility rests solely on restoring equivalence without punitive burden. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that correction restores dharma without inflicting suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate value-reconciliation process between transacting parties
Deploy automated equivalence-calculation engine based on prevailing dharmic metrics
Invoke responsibility-assumption protocol for initiating party until balance restored
Execute integrity-reintegration sequence upon successful recalibration of exchange
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: no temporal duration validates a transaction contrary to dharmic value. Justice flows from consciousness alignment, not punitive enforcement. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
